cluster_thesis.text: The 1.6T ramp is limited by supply, not demand. InP/EML lasers are short and LITE says 1.6T shipments are live to three customers in H2 CY26. Downgraded from strengthening to intact only because rates/FOMC risk is compressing multiples across the cluster. That is a valuation headwind, not a break in fundamentals.
cluster_thesis.falsifier: Module or laser makers post gross-margin compression while revenue grows at the Nov-2026 prints, or a supply study shows EML supply and demand in balance before end-2027.
